title: QuasarEdge Acquisition Corp 8-K Filing — 2026-04-17
summary: QuasarEdge Acquisition Corporation, a Cayman Islands-incorporated SPAC, completed its initial public offering of 10,000,000 units at $10.00 per unit on April 16, 2026, generating $100,000,000 in gross proceeds. The securities are listed on the NYSE under symbols QREDU, QRED, and QREDR.
key_points: IPO closed April 16, 2026 with 10,000,000 units at $10.00/unit = $100,000,000 gross proceeds
Each unit consists of one ordinary share (par $0.0001) and one right entitling holder to 1/4 share upon business combination
Listed on NYSE: Units (QREDU), Ordinary Shares (QRED), Rights (QREDR)
Private placement of 285,000 units to sponsor Aspira Capital Consulting LTD for $2,850,000
Underwriter Polaris Advisory Partners (Kingswood Capital Partners LLC) has 45-day option for 1,500,000 additional units
Registration Statement (File No. 333-294027) declared effective April 7, 2026
